searched: OpenAI’s own news feed (openai.com/news/rss.xml, 1,294 items, retrieved directly on 2026-10-15) was used to discover every company post from 2015 to October 2026 on boards, executives, safety teams, acquisitions and structure, and to date posts whose reader-relay text carries no date. openai.com pages were read through the reader relay (openai.com refuses direct retrieval); several returned HTTP 401 on first attempt and succeeded on retry. People’s own posts were found through web search and through status links embedded in TechCrunch, Gigazine, Decrypt, techstartups.com and TechNews articles (used for discovery only), then read through X’s syndication endpoint; long-form note posts come back truncated and image notes cannot be read, so Mira Murati’s and Bob McGrew’s September 2024 notes and Sam Altman’s 26 September 2024 transition note could not be machine-checked: TechCrunch reporting is cited for the Murati and McGrew departures and for Mark Chen’s SVP title. The reader relay refused x.com (abuse block), so no X post was read through it. Checked against existing records: the 2015 launch roster and co-chairs, Musk’s 2018 board departure, Dario Amodei’s 2020 departure, the 2019 LP, the November 2023 board events, Sutskever’s 2024 departure and Pachocki’s appointment, the Superalignment co-leads, the 2025 recapitalization and Christiano’s 2026 board appointment; none is duplicated. Not drafted: Greg Brockman’s August–November 2024 sabbatical and return (his posts were retrieved, but no predicate fits a leave of absence; the sabbatical post is used only for his self-description as co-founder); Aleksander Madry’s July 2024 reassignment and the interim preparedness leads (Altman’s post could not be located; only secondary aggregators were found); Lilian Weng’s reported 2026 return to OpenAI (reporting only); Kevin Weil’s 2025 move to OpenAI for Science as a dated event (his post was not located; his April 2026 post describes it retrospectively); Fidji Simo’s board status after May 2025 (no source states when she left the board); Mira Murati’s founding of Thinking Machines Lab (outside this group); Matt Knight, Srinivas Narayanan, Chris Clark, Anna Makanju and other Foundation staff (outside scope); OpenAI’s ‘OpenAI and Elon Musk’ posts (litigation material). The Internet Archive was not used.
